title: Prove naive exp overflows, safe softmax does not (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
4 rows of 6 logits, one thread per row; the first and third rows use logits around +-1000, where a naive expf(logit) overflows.
The grader rejects any non-finite output as well as any mismatch, so a naive (max-not-subtracted) implementation fails outright, not just inaccurately.
